overview_description.description: Transcribeglass offers assistive subtitle glasses designed for the hard-of-hearing and deaf community. The device can be retrofitted to existing spectacle frames, providing real-time captioning of conversations. This wearable technology aims to enhance communication accessibility by displaying live transcriptions directly on the glasses, making it easier for users to follow along in various settings. The company is currently in the beta phase, with early adopters able to reserve the device through their website.
